responsibility: This file provides shared OpenMP/OpenACC middle-end utilities that are reused across lowering, expansion, and offloading code. It owns generic clause queries, loop-header extraction into omp_for_data, canonicalization of loop conditions and increments, mappability and privatization predicates delegated through language hooks, OpenMP/OpenACC context-selector and attribute helpers, OpenACC routine compatibility checks and dimension handling, offloading-function classification, and common tree-building helpers such as component references with preserved qualifiers.
same_name_distinction: Provides the actual shared utility implementations used across the OpenMP/OpenACC middle end, such as clause lookup, loop-header extraction into omp_for_data, context-selector handling, OpenACC routine checks, and offloading predicates. Unlike gcc/omp-general.h, it contains the executable logic rather than the shared type and API declarations.
